summary.intent: Run /simplify on the phase-43 (feat/fuse-write-durability) branch changes to improve code quality via reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups — separate from the CodeRabbit bug-fix review already completed.
summary.outcome: Applied 3 safe, behavior-preserving cleanups (created_at_ms accessor, dead field removal, and_then refactor) across queue.rs, read_ops.rs, and windows/write_ops.rs. All 83 tests passed; committed as a separate refactor(43) commit on the branch.

repo: crates/sdk has no `dirs` dependency, so any helper needing directory resolution requires adding a new crate dep — a blocker for inline cleanup passes.
The fuser and winfsp write paths are symmetric and must receive the same micro-refactors in parallel (e.g., the .and_then() fix was applied to both read_ops.rs and windows/write_ops.rs).
winfsp code is Windows-only and cannot be cargo-checked locally; it relies on CI for compilation verification.

sync_cycle in sync.rs only counts statuses from load_all_for_vault — the real I/O cost is disk reads per file, not allocation, so count-only optimizations are low-value until the sidecar-ciphertext refactor (WR-06).
The journal-dir path and retry count (5) are triplicated across 3 call sites — a latent footgun identified but not fixable without the dirs dep.

code.finding: sort_by_key on JournalOp used a duplicated match arm to extract created_at_ms; extracted into a JournalOp::created_at_ms() accessor to eliminate the duplication.
Dead journal_entry_id field was carried through struct population and destructuring only to be suppressed with `let _`; removed entirely.
.map(|_| …).flatten() pattern on file_ipns_key_hex Option chain replaced with .and_then(|_| …).
Same .map(|_| …).flatten() → .and_then() fix applied symmetrically to the winfsp write path.

workflow: 1Password SSH signing failures require a restart of the agent before retrying the commit — background task pattern works well for the retry.
/simplify should defer any finding whose fix requires new crate dependencies, touches security-sensitive ordering paths (D-04/D-05), or affects un-compilable platform-specific code.
Running cargo check on fuse + sdk together after edits catches cross-crate breakage before committing.
Cleanup commits should be separated from bug-fix commits to keep history bisectable.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failed on the initial commit attempt, requiring a manual agent restart and a background retry task before the CR-03/CR-04 fix landed.
Journal-dir helper refactor (a real footgun) was blocked by the absence of the `dirs` crate in crates/sdk — the clean fix was not possible within a cleanup pass.
winfsp path cannot be locally compiled or cargo-checked, requiring review by inspection and reliance on CI for the Windows gate.
open_items: fuser↔winfsp UploadSpawnParams/journal-entry consolidation — all 4 review agents flagged this as the top structural issue; deferred because it touches D-04 fsync / D-05 plaintext ordering and the winfsp half doesn't compile locally.
Journal-dir path + retry count (5) triplicated across 3 sites — needs `dirs` dep added to crates/sdk before it can be extracted into a helper.
Count-only journal scan in sync_cycle — proper fix is the sidecar-ciphertext refactor (WR-06), not a partial optimization.
Option<String> typed journal keys — larger refactor beyond a cleanup pass.
replay_upload_entry → publish_file_metadata delegation and cas_publish_parent helper extraction.
resolve_folder_key memoization to avoid redundant resolution on hot paths.
Typed NotFound error variant instead of string matching.
